title: 80% of People Have 'Laundry Anxiety'
paragraphs: Do you ever worry about washing your clothes? If so, you are not alone. According to a new survey, eight out of ten people in the UK have some kind of "laundry anxiety."

The survey was done for Samsung, the electronics company, which makes washing machines. It asked 2,000 adults in the UK about how they wash their clothes. The results were shared at the end of October.

The survey found that 80% of people feel some kind of worry about doing laundry. Almost half, 47%, said they are afraid to wash certain clothes because they might ruin them. On average, people have four pieces of clothing they are worried about putting in the washing machine.

The clothes people worry about most are knitwear, clothes with decorations, coats and cashmere. Many people also worry about washing jeans. About 23% said they have never put their jeans in the washing machine. On average, people in the UK wear their jeans six times before washing them.

People have different ways of dealing with their worries. About 51% have washed clothes by hand in the sink, and 33% have paid for dry cleaning. Some people simply wear clothes again without washing them.

These worries may come from bad experiences. About half of the people in the survey said they had ruined clothes in the wash. The most common problem was clothes getting smaller. After a bad experience, 65% said they became more worried about washing other clothes.
Laundry anxiety can even change how people shop. About 55% said they did not buy something they wanted because they were worried about how to wash it.
